Swiss Army Bench 0.0.24

- **Update available sits in the top-right corner** of every window while there is one. A click warns first that
  Swiss Army Bench closes, installs the new version and opens again by itself, and lists any unsaved documents or
  running kernels; then **Update and restart**.
- **Packages you installed are kept** across updates and extension installs. Before, each one rebuilt the app's
  Python and dropped what Install now had added (for example `azure-identity`), so a connection failed with
  "No module named". Install them once more after this update; from then on they stay.
- **The rail:** APIs sits right after Connections.
- **Connections page:** the line pointing to the APIs page and the Writes / Read-only tag on each card are gone (a
  connection's detail still says what it writes).
